_comment: The GAME menu overlay (SCREEN_GAME, 8): wording, row rules and message ids. Geometry is boxes.json; every box there is the original's rectangle scaled by 2.25, and `native` below says which rectangle, per box. The whole group is then placed so the body's centre sits where the original's does in the MAP WINDOW, not in the window: see `_anchor_note`.
_anchor_note: TRANSCRIBED POSITION, 16 September 2026 (decision 69). LOADSAVE::Add_Game_Popup_Fields_ (loadsave.cpp:176-293) puts all four in-game dialogs at one fixed top-left, MOX::_popup_base_x = 0x90, _popup_base_y = 0x19 (:182-183, :205-206, :231-232; the centred branch at :225-229 is the MAIN MENU's Load), and _Draw_Main_Game_Popup_ draws GAME.LBX picture 0 there (:1356); pictures 0, 8, 11 and 14 are all 279x378, measured in the LBX headers. So the popup's centre is native (283.5, 214), which is 51.68 % across and 48.0 % down the map window (22,22)-(527,421) (Add_Grid_Field_, mainscr.cpp:1427) - near its centre and not on it, and nowhere near the 640x480 window's (320, 240). HD transcribes that PROPORTION against the galaxy map's own map_area box: in reference px the target is (90 + 0.5168 * 1422, 66 + 0.48 * 885) = (824.9, 490.8), and every box in boxes.json moved by (-53, +10) from the centred-4:3 placement, which put the body's centre at (878, 481). The smoke test holds the body's centre to the proportion within 1 ref px, so a galaxy frame that moves map_area fails it. help_popup is not part of the group: it is centred on the galaxy map's map_area, like the galaxy map's own.

frame._note: Decision 69: Data's fixed frame image around the popup body, plain-scaled with one factor so the opening covers the body box plus gmframe.BLEED, and centred on it. `opening` is the image's one transparent hole (alpha < 16, MIN_AREA 2000) as tools/frame_holes.find_holes measures it; the smoke test holds the two equal. Its aspect, 879:1193 = 0.737, is the body's 628:850 = 0.739, so the opening is the body. The octagon's interior is transparent: gmframe fills the opening from the cockpit texture before the frame is drawn, opaque and undimmed.

_native_note: 640x480 rectangles from Add_Game_Popup_Fields_ (loadsave.cpp:176-293), Confirmation_Box_ (gendraw.cpp:153-175, CONFIRM.LBX drawn at 0xa1,0x75) and Message_Box_Exploding_ (gendraw.cpp:90-127, WARNING.LBX at 0x9a,0x90, 0x14B x 0xBF). body, settings_title and slot_list are read off the native screenshots, not the source: the popup's frame is artwork (GAME.LBX 0, 29, 11, 14).

words._artwork_note: Every word above is ARTWORK in the original — GAME.LBX entries 1-6, 10, 12, 13, 15, 29 (Load_Game_Popup_Pictures_, loadsave.cpp:1177-1207) and CONFIRM.LBX (gendraw.cpp:167-175). There is no string to extract, so they are typed here from the native screenshots, per decision 15.
words.hd_state_slot: HD STATE: without MSG_SAVE_SLOTS (doc/ext_save_slots.patch, not applied) HD has no slot names, stardates, dates or status, and a row shows its number only. The original shows the description from SAVEn.GAM (filedef.cpp:207-243). Decision 60.
words._unknown_note: HD STATE: shown only when the overlay did not see which button led here (it was opened into a confirmation or warning) or, for the warning, without MSG_SAVE_SLOTS; the original prints H 186/187 and H 178-180 (loadsave.cpp:1241, :1258, :934-940).

settings_rows._label_note: HAROLD::H_Message_ 0xA6-0xB1 and 0x187, in row order (_Draw_Options_Game_Popup_, loadsave.cpp:1503-1523).
settings_rows._alt_note: Literals of the SCREEN path, loadsave.cpp:1504-1520, which is what the running game shows. The bitmap path used for the slide animation prints a different set (:1474-1487: F5-F8 on rows 5-8, no F4) and HD has no slide; reproduced as orion2re shows it, not repaired. Open fix 18.
settings_rows._checkbox_note: the checkbox field is 12 px tall on a 17 px pitch (loadsave.cpp:215, :218)
settings_rows._label_x_note: label at draw_x + 4 + width of GAME.LBX 9 = native 196 in the 170..398 row (:1500)

slot_rows._row_note: a slot field is 24 px on the 31 px pitch (loadsave.cpp:263)
slot_rows._name_x_note: text_x = popup base + 0x20 = native 176 in the 170..390 list (:850)
slot_rows._detail_y_note: stardate and date print at text_y + 14 of 31 (:885, :894)
slot_rows._invalid_note: literal, loadsave.cpp:856 — the engine also writes it into the description (:260, :271)
slot_rows._empty_note: H 388 '... empty slot ...': the stardate is not printed for a slot whose description is this string (:884)
slot_rows.omission_icon: OMISSION: the game-type icon at the right of every row (GAME.LBX 16/17/18, loadsave.cpp:833-846) is not drawn — that artwork is not extracted, and a word in its place would be an invention.

omission_sliders: OMISSION: the Music and Sound Fx sliders (loadsave.cpp:200-201, type-6 fields) are not in HD. Their value is written from the pointer by fields::Find_Bar_Position_ (fields.cpp:1702), which an activation cannot supply and decision 39's correction says an injected click loses. Data, 14 September 2026: leave out and mark. Their help regions 420 and 421 are omitted with them. Open fix 15 asks the question.
unverified_right_click: UNVERIFIED, NOT TRANSCRIBED: a right click inside the Save dialog outside every help rectangle returns -1, which Do_Save_Game_Popup_'s `input_id < 0` branch reads as `abs(-1) = 1` inside the slot field range and leaves for the menu (loadsave.cpp:568-574). Data's order: verify live first. It could not be run: the game is a native Wayland client that xdotool cannot reach, and every field centre in that dialog lies inside a help rectangle, so MSG_CANCEL_FIELD cannot produce the case. Until it is verified, HD does nothing there.

orionlayer_rows._hd_extension: HD EXTENSION (fundament 63, 64): five row heights below the thirteen engine rows - a divider, the OrionLayer heading, the map floor lift, the player-colour preset and the monster values switch for the Planets panel (default on). The game knows nothing about them: they have no field, their clicks send nothing, and their values live in core/usersettings.py. The hotkey column stays empty for all three rows.
orionlayer_rows._grow_note: The box grew by one band (153 -> 191 reference px, 14 September 2026) and settings_accept moved down by the same 38 so the rows still end above ACCEPT; 38 is one band of the engine rows (497 / 13), so the new row is as tall as every other.
orionlayer_rows._label_x_note: the engine rows' own label column (settings_rows.label_x), so the two lists align
orionlayer_rows._swatch_note: eight swatches from swatch_x to the right edge of the row, drawn from the SELECTED preset's base colours (core/playercolors.base), so they cannot disagree with what a restart will produce; swatch_gap is the gap between two as a share of one swatch
orionlayer_rows._restart_note: The restart note is drawn right-aligned in the HEADING band, directly above the preset row's swatches: four row heights leave no fifth for it. Shown only while the saved preset differs from the one palette.init applied (palette.active_preset), so it goes away by itself after the restart.
orionlayer_rows._value_x_note: 0.46 let 'Player colours' run into the preset name in the first offline render (14 September 2026); 0.50 leaves a gap at 1080p, and the swatches follow at 0.74
